matters.title: E. A Resolution approving the sole-source purchase of Motorola Communications APX next solution radio devices from Motorola Solutions, INC.
matters.text:
Agenda Item Details 

 Meeting 
 Jun 17, 2024 - 5:15 PM- Finance & Purchasing Committee 
 Category 
 2. New Business 
 Subject 
 E. A Resolution approving the sole-source purchase of Motorola Communications APX next solution radio devices from Motorola Solutions, INC. 
 Type 
 Action 
 Dollar Amount 
 83,032.81 
 Budgeted 
 Yes 
 Budget Source 
 244-624426493 
 Recommended Action 
 Staff recommends City Council approve a Resolution approving the sole-source purchase of Motorola Communications APX next solution radio devices from Motorola Solutions, INC. 

 Officers use the Motorola APX Next portable radios as the main form of communication for day-to-day operations with Dispatch, other officers, and fire personnel. Currently the Community Outreach Group (Co-Responder Unit) is relying on cell phones and extra spare radios for their communication. Motorola is the sole source provider for the police department radios and is purchasing the additional 7 radios from Motorola required to maintain interoperability within the department. This purchase would be fully funded by the grant received for the Co-responder unit. 

 Motion & Voting 

 Staff recommends City Council approve a Resolution approving the sole-source purchase of Motorola Communications APX next solution radio devices from Motorola Solutions, INC.

Motion by Ald Guzman, second by Ald Hayes.

 Final Resolution: Motion Carries

 Yea: Ald Newsome, Ald Bolton, Ald Hayes, Ald Florian, Ald Guzman

matters.body: 5:45 PM Special Public Works & Infrastructure Committee
matters.text:
Agenda Item Details 

 Meeting 
 Nov 04, 2024 - 5:45 PM Special Public Works & Infrastructure Committee 
 Category 
 3. New Business 
 Subject 
 D. Resolution approving the purchase of Radio Dispatch Consoles from Motorola Solutions per Sec. 2-458(i)(1)(Sole Source) for a not to exceed amount of $1,559,834.08. 
 Type 
 Action 
 Dollar Amount 
 1,559,834.08 
 Budget Source 
 232 323226498 
 Recommended Action 
 Staff recommends that members of the Public Works & Infrastructure Committee authorize the Mayor to approve a resolution approving the purchase of Radio Dispatch Consoles from Motorola Solutions per Sec. 2-458(i)(1)(Sole Source) for a not to exceed amount of $1,559,834.08. This will be for a seven year lease of $222,833.44 per year totaling $1,559,834.08. Funds to be charged to line item 232 323226498. 

 The purchase of the radios is part of the new dispatch center build. It is also to replace the current radios that are nearing end of life and will no longer be serviced or supported by Motorola in 2026. This also is to purchase additional positions from six to eight for the new center to expand the increasing demand for more personnel. 

 Motion & Voting 

 Staff recommends that members of the Public Works & Infrastructure Committee authorize the Mayor to approve a resolution approving the purchase of Radio Dispatch Consoles from Motorola Solutions per Sec. 2-458(i)(1)(Sole Source) for a not to exceed amount of $1,559,834.08. This will be for a seven year lease of $222,833.44 per year totaling $1,559,834.08. Funds to be charged to line item 232 323226498.

Motion by Ald Newsome, second by Ald Martinez.

 Final Resolution: Motion Carries

 Yea: Ald Florian, Ald Martinez, Ald Bolton, Ald Newsome, Ald Donnenwirth
